title: Issue stuck in_progress after agent crash
body:
Steps:
1. assign agent
2. kill it
Expected: lock clears
Actual: executionRunId stays set, issue locked. Environment: macOS, v1.2.3
author: alice

title: Stale executionRunId not cleared on release
body:
When I release an issue the executionRunId is not cleared so checkout returns 409. Steps:
1. checkout
2. release
Expected cleared
Actual stale
author: bob

title: Inbox badge count wrong
body: The inbox badge counts done issues. Expected only unread. Actual counts everything.
author: carol

title: Passwords written to server.log in plaintext
body:
Credentials and password values are leaked into the log file. This is a security vulnerability. Steps:
1. start agent with api key
2. cat server.log
Expected redacted
Actual plaintext secret
author: dave

title: App crash on save with large file
body:
Steps:
1. open a 2GB file
2. click save
Expected: saves
Actual: crash, TypeError at editor.ts:88
Environment: Windows 11, v1.3.0
author: frank

title: gemini session not found after token overflow
body: gemini adapter hits Invalid session id after a long conversation. Expected fresh session. Actual error.
author: grace

title: Feature request: dark mode for settings panel
body: Would love a dark mode toggle in the settings UI. Lots of people want this.
author: heidi
